title: Lumentum Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Fiscal Year 2026 Results
summary: Fiscal Fourth Quarter Highlights: Net revenue of $1.01 billion GAAP gross margin of 47.4%; Non-GAAP gross margin of 50.4% GAAP operating margin of 27.8%; Non-GAAP operating margin of 36.6% Forecasting first quarter of fiscal year 2027 revenue of $1.225 billion to $1.275 billion; Non-GAAP operating margin of 39.5% to 40.5%; and Non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $4.05 to $4.35 Lumentum Holdings Inc. (“Lumentum” or the “Company”) today reported results for its fiscal fourth quarter and full fiscal year ended June 27, 2026. “Lumentum is positioned at the heart of a secular industry shift. As AI compute workloads increase in both speed and bandwidth, data center architects are turning to optical links as a primary means of connectivity. While our Q4 results demonstrate broad-based traction, key growth drivers such as OCS solutions and our cloud module business, where we are advancing 1.6T adoption, are beginning to layer in.
